thread.title: Downtown Clayton to host first-ever restaurant week
thread.title_full: Downtown Clayton to host first-ever restaurant week

author: The Triangle Tribune
title: Downtown Clayton to host first-ever restaurant week
text:
1 days ago Luna Pizza Cafe Photo by Courtesy of Town of Clayton Submitted To The Tribune
CLAYTON – For eight days this July, local dining destinations will take center stage during the first Downtown Clayton Restaurant Week.
The inaugural event will celebrate local flavors, culinary creativity, and unforgettable dining experiences with special menus, exclusive offerings, chef spotlights, and limited-time experiences for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Restaurant Week, organized by Clayton's Downtown Development Advisory Board, will run July 13-20. Throughout the week, participating restaurants will offer prix fixe menus, new menu items, and exclusive experiences.
Participating restaurants:
* Aaktun
* Crescendo
* Fare Game
* First Street Tavern
* Jones Cafe
* Lover’s Bite (at Elixir VI)
* Luna Pizza Cafe
* Manning’s Restaurant
* Primo’s Pizza
* Romeo’s Pizza
* Snacks Provision Company
* Vinson's Pub + Eatery
"This week is about giving people a reason to try someplace new and fall in love with downtown Clayton through its food," said Paul Auclair, a member of the Downtown Development Advisory Board. "Our restaurants each bring something different to the table, and Restaurant Week creates a shared moment to celebrate the people, flavors and experiences that make this district so special. We hope it's the beginning of a tradition that residents and visitors look forward to year after year."
The event also shines a light on the chefs, restaurant owners, and teams who work every day to create memorable meals and welcoming spaces throughout downtown.
Additional details, participating restaurant specials, and featured offerings will be announced in the coming weeks. For updates and more information, visit Downtown Clayton’s Facebook event page.
